text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Now, next is checking this purchase order—...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Haaah...
I wonder if there's an Issun-boshi inside my head.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Neither medicine nor acupuncture is working. At this rate――

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"No! Times like these are when I show my true worth!
As if a little headache could ever beat me!"
